issue.title: Fix CSV upload
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the alerts & reports list.
2. Toggle an existing alert to `inactive`.

Expected behavior: the toggle persists after refresh.
Actual behavior: the alert flips back to `active` after refresh while the API returns HTTP 200.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/src/features/alerts/AlertList.tsx` and `superset/reports/api.py`.
Acceptance criteria: the toggle persists and the alert list tests pass.
